approvedRecipeBasis: User accepted the 34 proposed formulations on 2026-11-15; this does not turn nutrient estimates into measured facts.
method: Sum edible ingredient contributions and divide by the exact number of servings. Prefer metric quantities; imperial measurements are alternatives, never additional ingredients. Carbohydrates are available carbohydrate (USDA carbohydrate minus fiber; EU manufacturer values already exclude fiber). Unknown nutrient values remain null.
globalLimitations: Generic reference foods and explicitly named proxies are estimates, not the exact brand used by the cook.
No unmeasured cooking-loss correction is applied. Full wine energy, rendered meat fat, marinades and ordinary sauteing oil are included unless a recipe-specific override says otherwise.
Water gain/loss changes cooked weight but not ingredient totals per recipe. No per-100-g cooked-dish value is claimed.
Frying oil and coating retention are stated assumptions, not measured absorption. The reported sensitivity interval covers those assumptions only, not all food variability.
Rounding: calories to 5 kcal, macronutrients to 0.1 g, sodium to 10 mg. Nutrition is always marked estimated and per serving.

water.reason: Drinking water, nominal 1 g/ml; USDA portion 93025 is 1000 g per litre.

beef stock.reason: Water-like density assumption for prepared broth; not a measured density for a specific brand.

vegetable stock.reason: Water-like density assumption for prepared broth; not a measured density for a specific brand.

bay leaf.reason: Whole leaf is removed before serving; extracted trace nutrients are not modeled.

sunflower oil.reason: Estimated retained frying oil for 12 falafel. The 500 ml bath is not consumed in full; sensitivity is 30–60 g retained per whole recipe.
15 ml dressing oil converted with USDA 13.6 g/tbsp (=13.796121 g) plus assumed 20 g retained frying oil (sensitivity 10–30 g).

flour.reason: Assume half the 40 g dredging flour adheres; discard excess.

eggs.reason: Assume 35 g of the 50 g egg wash adheres; discard excess.

breadcrumbs.reason: Assume 50 g of the 70 g crumbs adheres; discard excess.

lime.reason: Assume 30 g juice from the listed 60 g lime; peel is not eaten.

cloves.reason: Whole cloves are removed before blending; extracted trace nutrients are not modeled.

ginger.reason: Use pickled ginger instead of raw ginger; source is a low-sugar canned variant, so sweeter brands differ.

guacamole.reason: Explicit generic guacamole proxy by mass: avocado 85%, onion 5%, tomato 5%, lime juice 4%, salt 1%; not a recovered brand formulation.

ajvar.reason: Explicit pepper-spread proxy: red pepper 80%, oil 10%, eggplant 5%, vinegar 4%, salt 1%; roasting concentration and brand variation are not modeled.

garam masala.reason: Explicit unsalted spice-blend proxy; actual blend proportions vary.

shawarma spices.reason: Explicit unsalted paprika/cumin/coriander/garlic/pepper proxy; separately listed salt is counted separately.

tandoori masala.reason: Explicit unsalted spice-blend proxy; actual blends vary.

yeast dough.reason: Explicit 300 g raw savoury dough proxy (flour, water, oil, dry yeast, salt); not baked bread or a recovered manufacturer's recipe.

paneer.note: Specific lower-fat paneer reference; other paneer can contain considerably more fat. Sodium derived from 0.1 g salt / 2.5. Fiber not declared and remains unknown.

nori.description: MUSO toasted sushi nori, specification dated 2025-03-03
nori.note: Manufacturer-declared EU available carbohydrate; not hydrated raw seaweed.

sumac.description: Culpepers ground sumac with salt, specification dated 2026-08-27
sumac.note: 1475 kJ divided by 4.184. Reference includes added salt; unsalted sumac differs. Fiber not declared and remains unknown.
